title: FTA IIJA: obligation and outlay shares rise under a larger adjusted-authority base
summary: FTA obligations rose from $37.280 billion to $56.710 billion and outlays from $18.595 billion to $34.573 billion; the obligation share moved from 48.2 to 57.3 percent and the outlay share from 24.0 to 34.9 percent. Denominator: FTA formula-plus-discretionary IIJA funding; adjusted authority changed from $77.356 billion to $98.931 billion.
